text: The Prophet, peace be upon him, told Umar: if you can... ask this man to pray for you.
He was not a king. Not a famous scholar. So why him?
The Prophet, peace be upon him, described him: Uwais, son of Amir, coming with the help from Yemen.
He had leprosy... and was cured of it, except a spot the size of a coin.
He has a mother... and he is dutiful to her.
If he swore by Allah, Allah would fulfil it.
Years later, whenever help came from Yemen, Umar, Razi Allah hu Anhu, asked them: Is Uwais among you?
Until one day... a man said: yes.
Umar asked him about everything the Prophet, peace be upon him, had said. Every answer was: yes.
Then the leader of the believers said to him: ask Allah to forgive me.
And Uwais asked Allah to forgive him.
Of all he could have said about this man, the Prophet, peace be upon him, mentioned his mother. Serve yours today.
